result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active contributors.

**Change:** in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, the unmatched-contributor branch now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped entirely, so their repositories don't get attached to the remainder either. Configured teams still take all their matched members, active or not.

**Blank dates:** `Contributor.isActive()` delegates to `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, which returns true for a blank latest-commit date. So contributors with missing dates stay in the remainder, as the task asks.

**Verification:** `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test` ran with no failures or build errors reported. No existing test covers this remainder logic, and I did not add one. I did not commit.
